You will assist in the implementation of NAVAIR CM related policy and procedures.
You will provide decentralized management and control of Engineering Change Proposals (ECP), Rapid Action Minor Engineering Changes (RAMEC); Interim Technical Directives (TD), and major/critical Variances.
You will maintain decentralized metrics files of all configuration management and/or Change Control Board (CCB) actions.
You will co-chair, operate and support decentralized CM process activities.
You will prepare and/or analyze new program acquisition or modification for CM requirements, processes and engineering change actions.
You will facilitate the technical and logistics review process and impact on existing airborne weapon systems and commonality issues as related to the CM competency.
You will carry out specific or collateral tasks and functions identified/assigned as CM related, such as the facilitating the review and analyzing retrofit documents.
You will prepare and maintain IPT Configuration Management Plan (CMP).
You will work with NAVAIR required CCB Change Request workbooks.
You will utilize the Enterprise ECP processing tool, currently ePower, for processing change documents.
You will serve as a Functional Configuration Audit (FCA) and/or Physical Configuration Audit (PCA) review team member.
You will also serve as the primary IPT member for CM and carry out assigned tasks and functions across all group-working levels.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-11/12 grade level or pay band DA-04 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Utilize a wide range of technical and business systems, processes, and practices used to manage weapon systems acquisition; 2) Review, analyze, and implement higher level procurement policies; 3) Manage project/program requirements, objectives and metrics, and resolving conflicts among schedules, funding, and resources; 4) Identify opportunities to incorporate process improvements and best practices utilizing customer feedback, internal and external audits, self-assessment, and lessons learned activities; 5) Advise management and colleagues on difficult problems, conducting special studies, proposing options and alternatives, and representing a command.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

The Program Analyst (Performance) contributes to the agency's strategic planning, performance management, and the digital transformation of how the Peace Corps conducts its business. Major duties fall into three areas: 1.

Data Analysis, Reporting & Visualization- Gathers, transforms, and analyzes large or complex datasets to produce clear, decision-ready insights, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate data transformation (e.g., writing and refining queries) while owning the analysis and interpretation.

Builds reports, dashboards, and visualizations using business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) so leaders and staff have ready access to reliable data Responds to data and analysis requests from internal staff, leadership, and the public, tailoring findings to the audience.

Automates recurring data collection, analysis, and reporting to improve speed and accuracy. 2.

Enabling Digital Transformation Across the Agency- Partners with offices across the agency and works closely with the Office of Information Systems (OIS) to ensure the Office of Planning and Performance (OPP) and agency staff have the data, tools, and workflows they need to do their jobs well.

Identifies opportunities to adopt new tools and better ways of working, and helps colleagues learn and adopt them. Contributes to responsible data governance and data-sharing practices in coordination with the analyst who leads that work, ensuring efforts connect to the broader transformation agenda. 3.

Strategic & Performance Planning- Supports development, review, and reporting for agency-wide strategic and performance products, including the Annual Performance Plan, Annual Performance Report, and quarterly performance reviews, consistent with OMB and Congressional requirements and timelines.

Helps interpret federal performance management law, policy, and practice and translate it into practical guidance for agency leaders and goal leads. Supports the design of accountability and strategic-alignment systems that help the agency execute on its priorities.

D or equivalent doctoral degree OR 3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree OR LL.M. in a field which demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the work of the position.

What We're Looking for in Top Candidates We're seeking a curious, adaptable analyst who is genuinely comfortable using and learning new tools - and who is excited, not hesitant, about working with AI as part of everyday practice.

This role is a strong fit for someone energized by emerging technology; it is not well suited to applicants who prefer to avoid AI-assisted tools. Strong candidates will bring several of the following.

We don't expect any one person to bring them all, we expect the ability to learn the rest quickly: - Comfort using AI tools to support data transformation (e.g., generating and refining queries) and document preparation - Experience with data and analytics tools, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new tools quickly - Familiarity with cloud data architecture - Knowledge of UI/UX and/or data visualization principles - Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software - People analytics / applicant tracking systems (ATS) - Marketing analytics - Survey research - Product development Please note: If you are qualifying based on education or a combination of education and experience, please review the "Education" section of this announcement.

Experience that satisfies the Specialized Experience requirements must be clearly documented in your resume. Failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Please review the "Required Documents" section of this announcement for further information on resume requirements.

Specialized experience may be gained in the public sector, private sector, or through volunteer service (e.g., National Service programs such as Peace Corps or AmeriCorps, or other organizations such as professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, or social groups). One year of experience refers to full-time work.

Part-time work will be credited on a prorated basis. For more details on qualification requirements, refer to the OPM Qualifications Standards Handbook for General Schedule Positions, available on the OPM web site.

As a Supervisory Management Analyst, you will: Direct, assign, and ensure timely completion of data liaison and governance projects and activities across all TIGTA business units. Adjust priorities and deadlines in order to address priority requests for projects.

When necessary, negotiate with heads of other units, deciding on and/or coordinating work-related changes, and advising superiors of problems. Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of data and artificial intelligence (AI) governance frameworks, policies, standards, and internal controls.

Ensure alignment of data and AI governance efforts with TIGTA mission, strategic goals, and statutory requirements.
You must meet the following requirements by the closing date of this announcement. Specialized experience: For the GS-14, You must have one year of specialized experience at a level of difficulty and responsibility equivalent to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service.

Specialized experience is defined as: - Identifying and analyzing data and systems that are necessary for auditors, evaluators, and investigators to meet their mission; AND - Working with IT officials to resolve barriers to accessing data and systems; AND - Developing policies, procedures, and relevant training for analyzing and managing data and system access; AND. - Engaging senior executives to reach agreement on or consensus about complicated data and artificial intelligence governance policy and internal control considerations through effective written and oral communication.

Time-in-Grade: In addition to the above requirements, you must meet the following time-in-grade requirement, if applicable: For the GS-14, you must have been at the GS-13 level for 52 weeks.

Time After Competitive Appointment: Candidates who are current Federal employees serving on a non-temporary competitive appointment must have served at least three months in that appointment.

Major duties include but are not limited to Serves as business intelligence (BI) and data mining analyst, performs analysis to support data warehouse development, deploys BI and reporting tools, and delivers self-service reporting and analytic solutions.

Prepares quantitative and qualitative analyses and research studies to include a wide array of benefits and health care-related issues. Plans the assembly and presentation of findings from assigned studies in graphic, chart, and narrative form, applying appropriate statistical and analytical techniques.

Prepares reports and maintain records as requested, and participate in the coordination, preparation, presentation, and communication of work-related information to the supervisor and appropriate stakeholders. Coordinating data from different databases in preparation for integrated analysis and interpretation of highly specialized data.

Develops procedures and recommends quality improvements in data collection and statistical information systems. Develops computer-programming applications to automate routine data query and extraction. Provides data processing support for VA surveys, program evaluation, and special studies.

Participates in special studies and fact-finding activities to develop required data and information for reporting purposes and prepares administrative reports. Develops recommendations for corrective actions and methods to achieve efficient and effective operations.

Maintains accuracy and data integrity of databases, spreadsheets, and data warehouses. Defines stakeholder and oversight audit requirements, prepares for, and maintains document and report readiness.

Utilizes various software packages, to include Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Minitab, SQL, and Visual Basic, to prepare special reports, forms, and correspondence necessary to support VCL functions. Provides consultation on statistical analysis applications.

Uses large, highly specialized databases to recover statistical information needed for studies and reports. Collects, organizes, analyzes, and interprets highly specialized Veteran data from large databases. Performs other duties as assigned. Work Schedule: Tour of Duty is typically Administrative Hours.

Tour is subject to change based on program needs. Compressed/Flexible: Authorized Remote: This is remote position. Selectees will work 100% of the time in a non-VA-owned space outside of the local commuting area of a parent station.

The employee's workspace must be suitable for conducting business and as such, remote employees are expected to provide a secure, distraction-free home-based worksite with reliable high speed internet connectivity.

The employee will be required to travel to the closest VA Medical Center or VA Outpatient Clinic for issuance of equipment, and as needed for technical support. Selectees will be required to self-certify that their remote workplace meets all safety, privacy, and internet speed requirements.

Selective Placement Factors (SPF) are a prerequisite to an appointment and represent minimum requirements for the position (skill, knowledge, ability or other worker characteristic basic to - and essential for - satisfactory performance of the job). Applicants who do not meet the SPF are ineligible for further consideration.

This position includes a selective placement factor. The Selective Placement Factor for this position is: Utilizes data mining techniques, business intelligence tools, Power BI, SharePoint, Macros AND Advance knowledge of statistical methods and experience applying analytical techniques to solve complex business or operational problems.

AND You may qualify based on your experience and/or education as described below: Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-09 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

In order to meet the minimum qualifications for this position, you must meet 3/5 of the following examples of specialized experience: Examples of specialized experience would typically include, but are not limited to: Knowledge of management principles, practices, and processes in order to design, develop, produce, analyze, and distribute program and project data; Knowledge and skill in utilizing structured query language (SQL) and reporting techniques; and knowledge of organizational procedures, techniques and systems sufficient to document processes to improve project management, productivity, efficiency, controls, and planning; Skill in preparing briefing charts, fact sheets, and staff reports complete with findings, analyses, recommendations, and other correspondence as needed; Ability to review and analyze data/reports from various automated systems and other sources to track the trends, effectiveness, and needed improvements to procedures and processes, to align with VA regulations and policies; Knowledge and skill in using data mining techniques, data warehouse, business intelligence tools, Power BI, enterprise data repositories and universes, SharePoint, Business Objects, and other applications such as MS Excel and MS Access in order to prepare a wide variety of project management reports and dashboards for program analysis and upward reporting.

OR, Education: Applicants may substitute education for the required experience.

To qualify based on education for this grade level you must have a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.M. if related, in a field that is directly related to the work of this position that demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work.

OR, Combination: Applicants may also combine education and experience to qualify at this level.

You must have an combination of specialized experience and education (beyond the first 2 years) in a field that is directly related to the work of this position that demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work equivalent to the total requirement of this position (e.g., 6 months of specialized experience and 1 year of post masters degree graduate education).

You will be rated on the following Competencies for this position: Accountability Attention to Detail Customer Service Decision Making Flexibility Integrity/Honesty Interpersonal Skills Learning Reading Comprehension Reasoning Self-Management Stress Tolerance Teamwork Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Note: A full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week.

Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

The Chief, BIDS, expends considerable effort planning, prioritizing, scheduling, assigning, and evaluating work based on its specific technical requirements, and matching that with appropriately skilled experience subordinates, for short-term activities, longer-term initiatives, and for ongoing production.

The incumbent reviews and advises on progress through analysis, observation, and positive interaction articulating both successes and areas for further focus. Establishes and sustains cooperative relationships with other resources in VBA and VA.

Displays leadership skills in leading SAFe Agile teams executing software development through articulation and direction of strategic initiatives, LGY Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and special projects. Engages stakeholders throughout the development process.

Provides organization expertise in developing measurable objectives and supporting various teams. Coaches, counsels, provides feedback on the work to maintain positive communication, engagement, and transparency with staff individually and collectively. The incumbent's communication efforts focus both on performance and behavior.

Provides proactive, well-planned communications of all types and media to program participants and LGY leadership, including complete and accurate end products, recommendations regarding LGY business needs, self-serve program analytics capabilities and program analysis are provided to program participants, field stations, VACO staff, and others.

Advises project and other stakeholders, including the Agile Management Office on status, directly and through Planview. Ensures that teams effectively utilize a SAFe Agile lean environment for software development, including the application of core SAFe competencies throughout any effort, to the extent that Data team members sit on ART teams.

Directly responsible for interpreting the VA/VBA/LGY All Employee Survey (AES) as it pertains to the PMDI/Data team and its members. The Chief takes affirmative actions to cause improvements using realistic action plans to improve perceptions of employee experience as measured by, for example, future year AES scoring.

Utilizes analytical skill, sound judgment, and the capability to understand, report, and address the implications and ramifications of program/project management, controls, and procedures applicable to the program.

As a PROGRAM ANALYST -Title 32, GS-0343-9, you will serve as the analyst and consultant for the management and administration of programs within the directorate or division. Serves as key coordination point for all program requirements. This work requires knowledge of management principles, organizational theory and techniques of analysis.

Knowledge of agency administrative guidance and operating procedures coupled with analytical ability is required to develop information required by the chief to determine feasibility and legality of proposed program and operational plans.

While this position is intended to assist managers, it is not responsible for establishing policies or managing resources. The position requires a more narrowly defined focus of a specific functional area, i.e., personnel, logistics, training, operations, etc.

Incumbent performs duties necessary to accomplish program analyst functions and provide for customer services in support of programs essential to state Army National Guard daily readiness missions. - Reviews, evaluates and analyzes obligations and expenditures.

Prepares directorate or division summaries from reports submitted by Major Subordinate Commands (MSC).

Summarizes and interprets significant data collected and relates this data to the organizations program actions; identifies and analyzes deficiencies in resource consumption, training, workload and scheduling, and evaluates deviations from standards, plans, and estimates to determine cause and impact on missions. - Assists management in interpretation and utilization of reports and information provided.

Develops various visual media to present trends, performance status, capability and related management information. Aids functional areas in identifying areas of record documentation and procedures that can be streamlined, combined or improved and initiates methods to operate under the new or revised system.

Implements management control plans. - Provides recommendations to subordinate organizations for proper management of programs. Recommends funding allocations and monitors expenditure to ensure allocations are being utilized as planned and are not being exceeded. Adjusts allocations as needed.

Report expenditure status to management and National Guard Bureau (NGB) as required. - Based on budget guidance received from higher headquarters, develops an annual budget.
GENERAL EXPERIENCE: Experience, education, or training in administrative, professional, investigative, technical or other responsible work which demonstrates analytical ability and a practical and theoretical knowledge of the functions, processes and principles of management. Experience using computer and automation systems.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: To qualify at the GS-09 level, applicant must have one year experience to at least the GS-07 level. Candidate must be able to communicate proficiently with other organizations. Experience with being able to review, evaluate and analyze obligations and expenditures.

Candidate should have experience being able to summarize and interpret significant data collected and compile reports and manage equations. A candidate must have experiences and training that demonstrate the abilities to follow directions, to read, retain, and understand a variety of instructions, regulations, policies, and procedures.

The primary purpose of this position is to provide program analysis work in support of daily operations, which include identifying and resolving a full range of administrative and personnel concerns affecting the Education Service. Major Duties Exercises supervisory personnel management responsibilities.

Advises and provides counsel to employees regarding policies, procedures, and directives of management. Selects or recommends selection of candidates for vacancies, promotions, details, and reassignments in consideration of skills and qualifications, mission requirements, and EEO and diversity objectives.

Develops, modifies, and/or interprets performance standards. Explains performance expectations to employees and provides regular feedback on strengths and weaknesses. Holds employees accountable for satisfactory completion of work assignments. Appraises the subordinate worker's performance ensuring consistency and equity in rating techniques.

Recommends awards when appropriate and approves within-grade increases. Analyzes and evaluates, on a quantitative or qualitative basis, the effectiveness of programs or operations in meeting established goals and objectives. Analyzes and prepares program status reports for review at all levels.

Performs analytical and evaluative work associated with program activities. Incumbent plans, develops, administers, and supervises policies, procedures and programs to efficiently and better accomplish the mission of the service at the Hospital.

Coordinates the preparation of all recurring and nonrecurring reports as required for VA Headquarters, and VISN12, quality improvement plan, JCAHO, CDR, CMR, financial/budget, ILL/copyright, service contracts, yearly journal purchases, and is the service's Collateral Duty Safety Officer.

Oversees suggestion and award, quality, and/or productivity programs. Oversees productivity programs in single mission/program organizations.

Responsibilities also include planning, developing and directing the administrative and program activities relating to budgeting, reference services, satellite broadcasts, interlibrary loans, circulation, journal maintenance and Library and Medical Media program coordination.

Performs program cost analyzes such as development of life cycle or other cost analyses of projects, or performance of cost benefit or economic evaluations of programs.

Organizes and operates an accounting system which tracks all obligations from service funds, obligations from other funds, subaccounts, outstanding orders, received orders, salary expenditures and fund adjustments. Prepares estimated obligations and spending reports for the Hospital management yearly budget meetings.

Conducts portions or phases of a cost-effectiveness study for operating or administrative programs. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Work Schedule: Full time Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm (Overlap tour of duty may be required pending department/facility customer service requirements as needed) Telework: This position is not authorized for telework. Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Stay current on evolving FinTech trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes shaping the BFSI landscape. Apply a continuous improvement mindset informed by software engineering principles, measurement, and delivery best practices.

Qualifications Bachelor’s degree inComputer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field. 8+ yearsof experience as aBusiness Analyst, including3+ years within the BFSI domain. Strong understanding of banking and/or insurance processes, includingcore banking, payments, digital channels, risk, and compliance.

Experience working withAPI-based integrations, microservices, and modern application architectures. Proficiency inSQLand data analysis to support requirement validation and business insights. Solid understanding ofSDLC,Agile/Scrummethodologies, and tools such asJIRA, Confluence, and Rally.

Strong documentation and communication skills with experience creatingBRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and sequence diagrams. Understanding of software engineering practices and delivery models such asLean, Agile, DevOps, and continuous improvement.

Demonstrated judgment, adaptability, and the ability to manage shifting priorities in dynamic environments. Ownership mindset with a strong focus on product, engineering, and client outcomes. Knowledge of regulatory and compliance frameworks such asPCI-DSS, AML, KYC, GDPR, and SOX.

Exposure toAPI Management, event-driven architecture, and cloud platformssuch asAWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience supportingdata migration, transformation, or modernization programsin BFSI environments is preferred. Professional certifications such asCBAP, CCBA, Scrum Master, or Agile BAare a plus.

About Oper
Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.
The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else.

Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.
A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Who We Are
Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst specializing in system and API integrations to join our Professional Services team.
This is not a traditional Business Analyst role focused primarily on backlog management, user stories, or application configuration. Your focus will be integration discovery and solution design.
You will work across different client environments, platforms, and implementation projects to determine how systems should communicate, what data needs to move between them, and how the integration should be designed.
You will be expected to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, research their integration capabilities, analyze API documentation, define data mappings and transformation requirements, identify technical constraints, and design practical integration solutions.
You will not simply document what a customer asks for. We are looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, identify gaps, evaluate alternatives, and recommend how an integration should work.
Strong critical thinking, technical curiosity, and independent problem-solving are essential for success in this role.
Start date: September 2026
️Contract type: Independent Contractor + Indefinite Contract
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 4 PM PST
Work mode: 100% remote
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the discovery and solution design of system integrations across different customer and internal projects.
Analyze source and destination systems to understand how data should move between them.
Research unfamiliar applications independently, including reviewing publicly available technical and API documentation before client discovery sessions.
Lead technical discovery conversations with customers, implementation teams, developers, and other stakeholders.
Identify the appropriate APIs, endpoints, operations, data sources, and integration mechanisms required to solve each use case.
Define end-to-end integration flows, including how information is created, exchanged, transformed, validated, and synchronized across systems.
Create detailed source-to-target data mappings, including field relationships, data types, transformations, required values, defaults, validation rules, and exceptions.
Identify integration challenges such as mismatched identifiers, data dependencies, synchronization requirements, system limitations, and error scenarios.
Propose practical technical solutions rather than relying on customers or developers to determine how the integration should work.
Translate business integration needs into clear and actionable technical specifications that development teams can build from.
Collaborate with engineering, implementation, QA, and client teams throughout delivery to clarify requirements and protect the integrity of the integration design.
Support integration validation and troubleshooting when necessary.
Work across multiple systems, customers, and projects and adapt quickly to changing technical contexts
What You Need to Succeed
Must-haves
4+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst, Integration Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Technical Consultant, Integration Consultant, or similar role.
Proven experience working on multiple system integration projects.
Experience taking integration requirements beyond discovery and contributing directly to integration solution design.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, and system-to-system integrations.
Ability to confidently read and interpret API documentation.
Strong understanding of JSON and XML structures and data exchange concepts.
Experience creating detailed data mappings between source and target systems.
Understanding of data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error-handling concepts.
Working knowledge of SQL and the ability to use or interpret queries for data analysis, validation, or troubleshooting.
Ability to understand unfamiliar software systems and determine how their integration capabilities can be used to solve a business problem.
Experience gathering technical requirements directly from customers and translating them into specifications for development teams.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working directly with North American clients or distributed international teams.
Ability to work independently and take ownership without requiring detailed step-by-step direction.
Nice-to-haves
Experience using Postman or similar tools to inspect and test APIs.
Experience with ETL processes or file-based integrations such as FTP/SFTP.
Familiarity with OAuth, API keys, bearer tokens, and other common authentication approaches.
Experience troubleshooting API or data-integration issues.
Previous software development or engineering experience.
Experience with enterprise SaaS products or ERP ecosystems.
Exposure to systems such as Medius, SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar enterprise applications.
Experience with financial, procurement, Accounts Payable, or Spend Management platforms.
What Success Looks Like
You will be successful in this role when you can receive a new integration challenge, quickly understand the systems involved, perform meaningful research independently, conduct an efficient discovery session, identify the right questions and technical constraints, and turn that information into a solution that developers can confidently implement.
Over time, we expect you to become someone the team can trust to enter an unfamiliar integration scenario and figure it out.
You should be able to represent Launchpad confidently in customer and partner conversations, make sound technical recommendations within your area of responsibility, and move projects forward without requiring constant escalation or supervision.
What to Expect from Our Hiring Process
Introductory Conversation (60 minutes) : Meet with our Talent team to learn more about Launchpad, our culture, working conditions, and the role. We will also explore your professional background, career interests, and overall fit for the opportunity.
Final Interview (60 minutes) : Meet with our Director of Professional Services for a deeper discussion about your technical expertise, consulting experience, client-facing skills, and the value you could bring to Launchpad and our projects.
Follow-Up Conversation (Optional, 30 minutes) : An additional conversation may be scheduled to clarify specific topics, meet another member of the team, or further explore technical or project-related experience.

The **Business Analyst - Drug Safety Systems** supports and enhances applications used by the Global Drug Safety organization. Working closely with business stakeholders, the role translates business needs into effective system solutions, supports complex reporting and analytics, and ensures systems operate in a compliant and efficient manner.
This position is ideal for an early-career professional with a strong technical aptitude and background in information systems, data analytics, or related technologies, who is interested in developing expertise in Pharmacovigilance processes, regulated systems, and business analysis within the pharmaceutical industry.

* Support the administration, configuration, and maintenance of Drug Safety Systems and related applications.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify improvement opportunities, and deliver effective system solutions.
* Support reporting and analytics activities, including standard and ad hoc reports related to medical surveillance, compliance, and operational metrics.
* Assist with implementation of new functionalities, system enhancements, and release activities.
* Perform system validation activities, including testing, documentation, and user communication.
* Act as a primary contact for system issues, coordinating resolution with IT teams and external vendors.
* Provide end-user support, troubleshooting, and training.
* Create and maintain system documentation, procedures (SOPs, WISs), and training materials.
* Ensure compliance with Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements, corporate policies, and applicable regulations.
* Continuously develop expertise in Pharmacovigilance/Drug Safety processes, systems, and industry best practices.

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Ideally 2-3 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, preferably within Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Development, or other regulated GxP environments. Experience gained through internships, trainee programs, or graduate roles is also valued.
* Interest in Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes, with a willingness to develop expertise in related systems and business processes.
**Technical Skills**
* Experience with data analysis, reporting, data visualization, and dashboarding tools; experience with Oracle Business Intelligence is an advantage.
* Knowledge of database concepts, data warehousing, and data management principles. Experience with SQL and PL/SQL is desirable.
* Experience with regulated business applications, such as Drug Safety Systems, Quality Management Systems, or Document Management Systems, is an advantage.
**Compliance & Quality**
* Understanding of Computer System Validation (CSV) principles and regulated environments; knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 is an advantage.
* Exposure to GxP environments and familiarity with GAMP 5 and ITIL concepts is beneficial.
* Strong quality mindset with attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate documentation and compliant processes.
**Personal Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn in a dynamic environment.
* Collaborative team player who contributes to a positive and respectful working culture.
* Fluent in English both written and spoken; knowledge of French or German is an advantage.

* **Purpose-driven work:** Contribute to systems that support patient safety and help ensure the safe use of innovative medicines worldwide.
* **Meaningful impact:** Join a collaborative team where your ideas and technical expertise directly contribute to improving business processes and regulated systems.
* **Modern ways of working:** Collaborate with experienced professionals in an environment that values teamwork, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Identify process bottlenecks, duplicate activities, manual workarounds, control gaps, rework, and opportunities for standardization or automation.
Facilitate interviews and workshops in a manner that encourages candid input from employees and stakeholders impacted by future process changes.

ACH and share-draft exception processing
Returned deposits
ACH research and reclamations

Remote/mobile deposit review
Exception and research workflows

Develop recommendations for prioritizing automation opportunities based on business value, implementation complexity, risk, volume, and readiness.
Ensure future-state workflows appropriately address exceptions, escalations, human review, and audit requirements.

Partner with solution architects, developers, AI specialists, security teams, and business SMEs to ensure proposed solutions address operational requirements.

Support change-readiness assessments, communications, training, knowledge transfer, and transition planning.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.
Das Projekt
Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.
Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.
Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.
Aufgaben
Die Rolle
Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.
Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.
Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.
Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Are you interested in intelligent systems that accompany millions of letters and parcels on their journey every day? Are you passionate about analysing complex processes and developing sustainable solutions with various specialist units? In this role, you shape the further development of a business-critical coding solution at the interface between IT, logistics and automated sorting systems. You help us ensure reliable, future-orientated processing of consignments throughout Switzerland.
**How you make a difference **
* You analyse and document specialist and technical requirements and derive clear, implementable system requirements and specifications in accordance with defined standards.
* You work with specialist units, IT staff and software suppliers, taking advantage of your expertise to develop feasible solutions and clarify interfaces, dependencies and impact on existing processes.
* You coordinate changes between business, IT, operations and external partners and support them throughout the process, from the definition of requirements through to productive implementation.
* You plan releases, create test concepts and test cases, carry out integration tests and ensure production readiness with those involved.
* You analyse incidents across various systems, interfaces and processing steps, identify their causes using logs, monitoring data and alerts, and devise sustainable solutions for stabilizing and optimizing operations.
* You help shape the technological development of our application landscape and make targeted use of modern resources, including AI-supported tools.
* You work with your team to ensure reliable operation and take care of regular daytime and on-call services.
**What you have to offer **
* You have a university degree in informatics, business informatics or a related field, as well as several years of experience in business analysis, application management, system and integration engineering or IT operations.
* You can translate specialist requirements into technical specifications and liaise confidently between business, operations, development and external partners.
* You are enthusiastic about complex systems, interfaces and asynchronous message flows, and you analyse error patterns in a structured manner using logs and monitoring data, making a valuable contribution.
* You have experience with tests and releases and take responsibility for everything from analysis to introduction; knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, APIs, Kafka, MQTT, Splunk, Grafana or image and text recognition is an advantage.
* You have a very good spoken and written command of German and English, work independently and methodically and play an active role in agile teams.
* You are willing to work regularly in Bern and, if required, at parcel and letter center locations throughout Switzerland.

## Introduction ##
Pour notre division **Systèmes d-Information**, nous recherchons un **Business Analyst - Prévision et Planification** afin de renforcer l'équipe "Demand".

Au sein d-une organisation orientée produits Agile, vous contribuerez à la conception, l-évolution et la sécurisation des processus métiers supportés par nos solutions de prévision et de planification, notamment Maestro et SAP.

La mission principale sera d'assurer la liaison entre les équipes métiers et les équipes techniques pour garantir la bonne compréhension des besoins.
## *Responsabilités* ##
* Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métiers dans les domaines de la prévision et de la planification
* Contribuer à la définition de solutions adaptées aux besoins métiers, en favorisant l-utilisation des standards des outils retenus
* Participer à la conception et à l-évolution des processus dans l'APS Maestro, l-ERP SAP et les solutions associées
* Réaliser ou coordonner les paramétrages fonctionnels nécessaires dans les solutions retenues
* Rédiger les user stories, les spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées et contribuer aux spécifications techniques
* Suivre, tester et valider les développements réalisés par l-équipe
* Participer aux projets de déploiement, de transformation et d-amélioration continue des solutions informatiques
* Accompagner les utilisateurs finaux lors des phases de test, de formation, de déploiement et de stabilisation
* Contribuer à la qualité de la solution, de la documentation et des processus supportés
* Assurer une veille sur les bonnes pratiques de prévision, planification et utilisation des solutions APS.
## *Profil* ##
* Diplôme d-ingénieur, Master ou formation équivalente en informatique, logistique, planification, supply chain, commerce ou domaine connexe
* Expérience d-au moins 3 ans dans un environnement APS, ERP ou solution de prévision/planification
* Connaissance de Maestro ou d-un autre outil de planification avancée : SAP APO, SAP IBP, OMP, Blue Yonder ou équivalent
* Aisance dans la rédaction de spécifications, user stories, scénarios de tests et supports utilisateurs
* Esprit d-analyse et de synthèse
* Capacité à comprendre des processus complexes et à les structurer
* Rigueur dans la documentation, les tests et le suivi des décisions
* Sens du service et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs métiers variés
* Curiosité pour les solutions de planification avancée et les standards APS
* Capacité d-adaptation à des périmètres fonctionnels évolutifs.
## Conclusion ##
Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d-excellentes conditions de travail, des solutions de flexibilisation du temps de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.
Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).
